pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions on the lateral flank. Edges show a high contrast, sharp gradient against the lighter corridors. Shape complexity and angularity increase towards the hindquarters where patches become smaller and more densely clustered.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Pathways maintain a relatively uniform narrow pixel width. Junction nodes are clearly visible as vertex points typically connecting three to four adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A thin, dark, jagged silhouette is visible along the superior edge of the neck. The serrations exhibit a low-amplitude, high-frequency pattern against the background foliage.
